description: Check an expense claim against an amount limit, allowed categories and receipt rules. When a claim must be checked against a stated policy. Do not choose this when the policy varies by role, project or period. Example requests: Check these expenses against our policy. | Which expense claims break the rules? | Audit this expense claim for missing receipts.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

expenses.description: The customer's expenses.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The expense rows. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

policy.description: The customer's policy.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. One 'key=value' policy line per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_expense_policy_checker
title: Expense policy checker
